source: Stable Batch 10-14 implementation; final root command matrix; independent late security/backend reviews; explicit external-gate inventory
summary: Batches 10-14 implement administrator/profile/account management, optimistic system settings, monitoring/audit and chart-ready data, Sentry/Netlify/security integration, scaffold retirement, and release-level E2E/visual/accessibility paths. The final local matrix passed 98 test files and 568 tests plus all static/build/scan checks. E2E passed 8 public tests and explicitly skipped 18 authenticated tests for absent credentials; the guarded DB suite loaded and skipped 6 tests without an authorized disposable database.
